newsitem.title: POLAND: Allianz BGZ Polska gets property insurance licence.
newsitem.headline: Allianz BGZ Polska gets property insurance licence.

text.p: A joint venture between Germany's insurance giant Allianz AG Holding and Poland's Bank Gospodarki Zywnosciowej (BGZ) received a licence to sell property insurance in Poland, the Rzeczpospolita daily said.
The business daily said on Saturday that the new insurance firm, Towarzystwo Upezpieczen Allianz BGZ Polska SA, has a share capital of 14 million zlotys.
Poland's large agriculture bank BGZ will have a controlling stake in Allianz BGZ Polska until 1999 although Allianz has put up more than half of the share capital.

The paper quoted unnamed sources as saying that Allianz BGZ Polska was granted the licence on the premise that it would rescue ailing Polish insurer Felix SA, which has about two percent of the country's property insurance market.
The Rzeczpospolita said Allianz BGZ Polska was also trying to get a licence to sell life insurance policies.
